title: Diagnostic Review: FastAPI Low-Latency LLM Serving Route
description: Inspect an asynchronous FastAPI model serving endpoint for synchronous CUDA blocking, unbudgeted generation length, and process-global tensor caching.

artifact.content:
import torch
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()
GLOBAL_ACTIVATION_CACHE = []

class InferenceRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str
    temperature: float = 0.7
    max_tokens: int = 1000

@app.post('/v1/generate')
async def generate_response(req: InferenceRequest):
    # Explicit hardware barrier blocks async event loop for concurrent requests
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(req.prompt, return_tensors='pt').cuda()

    # Missing maximum generation ceiling allows unbounded token loops
    out = model.generate(tokens, max_new_tokens=req.max_tokens * 100)

    # Storing unquantized FP32 output tensors in process memory creates GPU memory leak
    GLOBAL_ACTIVATION_CACHE.append(out)

    decoded = tokenizer.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
    return {'response': decoded}

defects.title: Synchronous CUDA Device Barrier in Asynchronous Event Loop
defects.consequence: Invoking torch.cuda.synchronize() inside an async endpoint blocks the main asyncio thread, stalling all incoming requests.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Offload inference to a dedicated thread pool or asynchronous serving runtime (e.g. vLLM engine).

defects.title: Unconstrained Generation Budget Without Server Enforcement
defects.consequence: Permitting 100x user token budgets without an upper guardrail causes VRAM exhaustion and server timeout denial-of-service.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Enforce strict server-side maximum token limits and use streaming decoders.

defects.title: Process-Global In-Memory Tensor Cache Accumulation
defects.consequence: Appending output tensors to a global module list retains GPU memory allocations indefinitely, causing Out-Of-Memory crashes.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Do not retain raw GPU tensor activations in unevicted global collections.
